description: Remediate the resume at /home/ga/Documents/resume_draft.docx to be ATS-friendly. (1) Move the contact information (Name, Email, Phone, LinkedIn) from the Page Header into the top of the main document body. The Header must be left empty. (2) For the 4 dated entries (Job titles and Degree), remove the long runs of spaces separating the text from the date, insert a single Tab character, and set a Right Tab Stop at 6.0 inches to align the dates to the right margin. (3) Apply the 'Heading 1' paragraph style to the section titles 'EXPERIENCE', 'EDUCATION', and 'SKILLS'. Save the result as /home/ga/Documents/resume_final.docx.
